description.value: Jingle Bao is a Chinese restaurant on Denman Street specializing in handmade xiao long bao, all-day dim sum, and steamed buns — all freshly made and never frozen. Sitting two blocks from Stanley Park, it occupies a prime spot on one of Vancouver's busiest cycling corridors connecting the Seawall to the West End. The menu ranges from signature colorful soup dumplings and har gow to noodle soups, fried rice, and sharing platters.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 38m; stands (2 spaces) at 41m; stands (2 spaces) at 82m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms address (774 Denman St., Vancouver, BC V6G 1C9), phone ((604) 428-7722), and active dine-in, takeout, and delivery service. The menu prominently features multiple vegetarian items (Vegetable Xiao Long Bao, Steamed Vegetarian Dumplings, Vegetable Spring Rolls, etc.). No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site; those fields are set to null per absence-of-evidence rules.
